personality_one_liner: A premium, restorative sanctuary that feels more like an elegant lifestyle magazine than a clinical booking tool.

spacing.rule: Magazine-like spacing rhythms with generous vertical breathing room. Let typography and whitespace carry the hierarchy. No dense card-heavy layouts.

do's: Use solid surface or surfaceSecondary for all elevated surfaces
Rely on spacing and subtle dividers rather than blur
dont's: No glass effects. The editorial personality relies on matte, paper-like surfaces and stark contrasts.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A calming discovery feed showcasing today's schedule and inviting users to book their next session.

states.loading: Centered minimal spinner with subtle breathing animation.
states.empty: N/A - Admin managed content, assuming content exists.
states.error: Elegant text message 'Unable to load studio schedule' with a simple 'Refresh' text button.

screens.layout: Header with simple text greeting ('Good Morning'). Two large, edge-to-edge or generously padded hero cards stacked vertically for 'Pilates Classes' and 'Physiotherapy'. These cards must use the real photos with a gradient-to-dark scrim (top-to-bottom) and elegant serif text overlaid at the bottom left. Below, a horizontal scrolling list of 'Our Specialists' (circular avatars).

screens.name: Browse Schedule
screens.purpose: A clean, easily scannable calendar view to find and book available Pilates classes or Physio slots.

states.loading: Skeleton rows reflecting the list layout.
states.empty: Calm leaf illustration. Text: 'No sessions available for this date.'

screens.layout: Top section: A segmented control or simple text-based chip row (Physio vs Pilates) using brandTertiary for active state. Below: A horizontal scrolling date picker (Day/Date). Body: Vertical list of available sessions. Each row has generous padding, separated by 0.5pt dividers (no cards/shadows). Shows time, session name, instructor, and a subtle 'Book' CTA.

screens.name: Booking Detail Sheet
screens.purpose: A focused, distraction-free confirmation step for booking.

states.loading: Inline loading on the CTA button.
states.error: Inline red text above the CTA.

screens.layout: Opens as a bottom sheet. Top half shows session details with an elegant serif headline. Middle section shows Instructor profile snippet and Cancellation policy. Bottom is a sticky primary CTA 'Confirm Booking' floating above safe area. Background is solid surface.

screens.name: My Bookings
screens.purpose: Overview of user's commitments with options to manage them.

states.empty: Large calm leaf illustration. 'No upcoming sessions. Take time for your body.'

screens.layout: Top tabs: 'Upcoming' / 'Past'. Clean vertical list. Each booking is a distinct block with a surfaceSecondary background, sharp corners (md radius), displaying date, time, type. Includes subtle secondary buttons to 'Reschedule' or 'Cancel'.

screens.name: Therapist Profile
screens.purpose: Builds trust and highlights the expertise of the staff member.
screens.layout: Hero image at the top (therapist photo or studio shot), 30% screen height. Clean white surface overlapping it with the therapist's name (Display Serif) and specialties. Generous reading width for the bio. Below the bio, a list of their immediate available slots.

empty_state_illustration.alt: Calm minimalist green leaves in a dark room

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'Editorial Mobile' personality. The app should look like a high-end wellness magazine, not a generic SaaS booking tool.
Use Cormorant Garamond for all headings/titles and Satoshi for all body/UI text. Do not use weights above 500.
Avoid shadows and blur/glassmorphism entirely. Use flat surfaces (surface and surfaceSecondary) and clean 0.5pt dividers to create hierarchy.
Whenever text is placed on top of hero images (e.g., Home screen cards), a vertical gradient scrim MUST be applied (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to ensure text contrast.
Maintain generous padding (xl/2xl) around content blocks. Do not cram elements together.
The primary action buttons (like 'Confirm Booking') must be sticky at the bottom, placed inside a KeyboardAvoidingView/SafeAreaView, and easily reachable by the thumb.
Ensure My Bookings empty state uses the provided calm leaf image covering a generous portion of the screen with elegant text.
Do not use emojis anywhere in the UI.
